materialized_record.payload_text:
Document Index: Synthetic Enterprise Architecture Manual ARCH-DOC-1547.
Section 1.1: General Overview of Microservice Topologies.
All microservices communicate via gRPC or asynchronous message queues.
Telemetry is collected via OpenTelemetry collectors and exported to central dashboards.
Service discovery relies on Consul clusters deployed in redundant availability zones.
Database connections use pooled TLS 1.3 connections with mutual authentication.
